topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I don't know what I was expecting when I stumbled upon that piece of paper tucked away in the back of the drawer, but it certainly wasn't a list of things my partner dreams of doing. Each item, written in that unmistakable scrawl, felt like a finger pointing at everything I hadn't given them, everything we hadn't achieved. It’s bad enough living in the shadow of those expectations, but to have it laid out in stark contrast to the mundane routine of our days is a different kind of torment. So, I read through it, every line a silent accusation. And now, here I am, supposed to act like it’s nothing, like I didn’t just uncover a map of all the places we’ve never been and might never go.
